data.description:
## Description
**What**: Add a mutation-testing phase to the consolidated /dso:onboarding that leads with tradeoffs, detects in-scope stacks, applies single-stack-auto-default / multi-stack-confirm, writes config, copies the workflow, and ensures CI auth scope.
**Why**: Makes mutation testing adoptable by consuming projects without fragmenting across init+onboarding.
**Scope**:
- IN: tradeoff context block BEFORE per-stack questioning (CI time cost, false-positive context, one sentence on maintainer obligation when bugs fire); stack detection via manifest files (Python pyproject.toml/setup.py; Ruby Gemfile; JS/TS package.json; Go go.mod); single detected stack auto-enables with the one-line --mutation-off notice; multi-stack per-stack Socratic-confirm after the tradeoff block; writes mutation.<stack>.enabled to dso-config.conf; copies mutation-testing.yml to .github/workflows/; ensures tickets-branch push permission scope in CI auth; documents bash as unsupported with ecosystem rationale.
- OUT: create-dso-app.sh scaffolding (draft-6).
**EXTERNAL BLOCKER**: This story requires the consolidated /dso:onboarding delivered by external epic 136b-6758-ba12-47fc (HARD dependency). It is NOT a child of this epic and is intentionally absent from depends_on (cross-epic). Phases 1-4 ship independently; do not start this story until 136b-6758 has landed the unified onboarding skill. If 136b-6758 slips, this story is rescoped per the epic's planning residual.

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, the /dso:onboarding mutation-testing phase presents the tradeoff context block (CI time cost, false-positive context, maintainer-obligation sentence) before any per-stack question ← Satisfies: sc-6
- When this story is complete, onboarding detects in-scope stacks from manifest files and, for a single detected stack, auto-enables it while printing the one-line "Mutation testing defaulted ON for <stack> — run /dso:onboarding --mutation-off to disable" notice ← Satisfies: sc-6
- When this story is complete, a multi-stack project receives a per-stack Socratic confirmation after the tradeoff block and onboarding writes the resulting mutation.<stack>.enabled keys to dso-config.conf ← Satisfies: sc-6
- When this story is complete, onboarding copies mutation-testing.yml into .github/workflows/, ensures the tickets-branch push permission scope exists in CI auth configuration, and documents bash as unsupported with the ecosystem-limitation rationale ← Satisfies: sc-6
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic (stack detection, single-stack auto-default, multi-stack confirm, config writes, workflow copy) ← Satisfies: sc-6

## Considerations

- [Blocker] HARD external dependency on 136b-6758-ba12-47fc (consolidated /dso:onboarding). This story cannot start until that epic lands; flagged as external blocker in the description rather than an in-epic depends_on.
- [Anti-sycophancy] Per bot-psychologist: tradeoffs must lead the dialogue before per-stack questioning to avoid an enable-by-default sycophancy bias.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a project operator onboarding a repo, I want /dso:onboarding to offer a tradeoffs-first mutation-testing phase, so that mutation testing is enabled for my detected stacks with informed consent.
